MINI_CMIX/VIRTUAL_REPLAY/POSTR1_TRANSFORM correctness-blocked (2026-08-14/15 investigation): tested 6 build configurations for G5 bit-exact calibration. Only the original DONOR_DISCOVERY=1-only binary (/root/fx4_page_donor_v3/cmix_page_donor) reproduces G5 exactly (SHA-256 ab988693a74da0455fa77e5cbdd04c0c4a37d55e88c87e5c56387ca687fed642). Every other tested combination (full combined build, MINI_CMIX alone, VIRTUAL_REPLAY alone, DONOR=1 POSTR1=1 with no extra flags, and DONOR_DISCOVERY=1 + all three flags together) produced byte-identical corrupted output (854,810 bytes matching total size but diverging from byte 734,990 onward, SHA-256 18607f5d3da0821dc8c7907f40bc7b5c8f1e11386a242055b14174e94b2ec14e) regardless of which specific flags were present. Ruled out: madvise/mmap PPM-heap-residency dropping (adding DONOR_FORK_DISCOVERY=1 back did not fix it once other flags were present), stale/contaminated WSL source (verified predictor.cpp/predictor.h in the build tree predate the other agent's edits, dated Aug 9), rand()/static-initializer ordering (srand(SEED) is called explicitly and deterministically in main(), after static init), and PostR1Experts struct-size changes (no conditionally-compiled members in postr1_experts.h). Root cause NOT identified despite this ruling-out; would need a debugger or git bisection (no git repo available) to pin down further. Selective mini-cmix, SCR2 (virtual-replay), and LSTM-200 shadow-mode testing all remain blocked on this until a proper source-level fix is found -- not attempting further blind patches. Donor-profile search via the proven cmix_page_donor binary remains the only verified-safe mechanism.
